title: The treasure box
scene: ROB kneels beside a hinged wooden chest, lifting its lid while Puppy stretches to peek in; three-quarter floor view.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original finished portrait children's coloring-book illustration, not a montage. Black bold smooth outlines on pure white paper; no color, gray, shading, hatching, microtexture, text, letters, numbers or border. Preschool ages 3-5: large easy-to-color closed spaces, broad shapes, expressive animation-quality drawing. Important: ROB is a friendly original robot with a wide rectangular riveted head, TWO LARGE ROUND EYES with SIMPLE EMPTY CONCENTRIC CIRCLES (no stipple, mesh or texture), tiny smile, boxy chest, articulated claw hands and two caterpillar tracks (no human legs). Puppy is a small floppy-eared dog with a plain collar. Include only characters named in this scene. Character must be drawn specifically doing the scene's action, with natural interaction, varied perspective; not a stock standing front view. Rich coherent scene but only 4-6 main elements with big shapes. Fill most of a 2:3 portrait page; generous white print margin; all subjects fully readable.
